base_frame:
Q: Write a postcard from a lighthouse keeper.
A:

steered.text:
**[Front of Postcard]**
*(A sketch of a rugged lighthouse tower perched on a cliff edge, with crashing waves below and a solitary figure standing at the window looking out at the horizon.)*

**[Back of Postcard]**

**My Dearest Elara,**

The fog is thick tonight, rolling in off the sea like a heavy wool blanket that never seems to dry. It makes the job harder,
